# Deprecated Agent VM Vault Inspiration

## Why it matters
The old vault is significant prior art for EMA because it already encoded a practical agent-readable knowledge system with:
- frontmatter discipline
- wikilink density
- QMD search conventions
- ontology/graph extraction ambitions
- inbox/write protocols
- quality scoring
- memory activation/metabolism
- self-describing structure

## Strongest steals

### 1. Frontmatter enforcement as hygiene, not aspiration
The old vault explicitly enforced fields like:
- title
- created
- updated
- type
- status
- source
- tags
- summary

That is exactly the kind of minimum schema EMA’s QMD graph wants.

### 2. Wikilink densification and links-per-file metrics
The old vault measured:
- wikilink coverage
- average links per file
- orphan reduction

That is very useful for the EMA deliverable. The graph should be measurable, not just vaguely connected.

### 3. Inbox/default landing zone for agent writes
The old vault had a clear write protocol:
- inbox first
- classify later
- auto-promote/auto-sort over time

EMA should adopt this pattern for graph capture instead of pretending every write lands perfectly in its final home.

### 4. Vault metabolism / activation model
The old vault already had an ACT-R-inspired memory metabolism system:
- retrieval logging
- activation scores
- promotion/demotion behavior
- activation-weighted search

That is highly relevant for EMA memory, recall, and graph ranking.

### 5. Quality baseline / scorecard
The old vault had a measured quality baseline using metrics like:
- frontmatter completeness
- wikilinks
- summary presence
- source validity
- note length

EMA should absolutely have something similar for the deliverable folder.

### 6. Explicit source-of-truth behavior
The old vault said the vault was the single source of truth and expected direct filesystem write/read, not app dependency. That is the right spirit for EMA’s QMD deliverable too.

## Best adaptations for EMA
- use QMD frontmatter consistently
- measure graph quality over time
- introduce inbox/capture -> classify -> promote pipeline
- add activation-weighted query behavior later
- preserve provenance and freshness on every important page
- keep direct filesystem truth as baseline, richer UI later

## Best next docs to add
- QMD graph quality score rubric
- inbox / capture / promotion pipeline
- activation-weighted graph querying notes
- graph health log
